column2: why nothing can be resolved. A link whose target names no entity in the source map: the author pointed an output at an entity that was never placed (or was stripped before compiling), so there is nothing to convert and the engine ignores it too. Listed in coverage as links_dangling, not links_unresolved. Add a row only after checking the entity lump for the name.
the door's PlaySound output stops sound entities (stop_sound_room1..12) that the compiled map does not contain; the door still plays its own sounds
